feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 August 2026 9:36am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 30 August 2026 at 9:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure lies to the west of Ireland, bringing a frontal zone across the area today.


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, backing south or southeast for a time this afternoon, increasing 4 or 5 this evening, before veering west or northwest overnight. Increasing 5 or 6 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then showers or longer spells of rain in the afternoon and evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain and showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 Monday afternoon, then backing southwest Tuesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate at first, then slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
